notes: Only C1 and C2 are in scope (C3 is novelty, C4 and C5 are presentation). Referees reviewed NC Version 0, already a revision of an earlier submission; the paper given is arXiv v1, which predates it, so neither fix is present. B attacks the entropy plateaus head-on (non-monotonic S creates the plateaus, theory shows none) and states the THF picture is not discriminated from alternatives, matching both concerns directly. A touches the plateaus only via a robustness question on the three-point fit and the CNP reference, and the heavy-fermion reading only via an exchange-correlation alternative for the mass, so both are partly. B is much longer with many substantive extras; A has fewer, several generic practice checks.
